Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. listing_title: 2012 Toyota Camry XLE – Very Low Miles – One Owner
description:
It’s really hard to part ways with our beloved Camry, as it’s been part of our family since we bought it brand new. With our family growing, we’ve reached the point where we need something bigger, so it’s time to find it a new home. We’ve taken great care of it over the years, and we hope its next owner enjoys it just as much as we have.
This is a 2012 Toyota Camry XLE with only 101,000 miles which is super low for its age. We purchased it brand new off the showroom floor with just 13 miles on it, making us the original owners. It’s the V4 model that is a great powerful gas saver.
The vehicle has been garage-kept all of its life and meticulously maintained. All maintenance is up to date, and we still have a complete folder of service records and oil changes every 5,000 miles on the dot. The vehicle has never been involved in an accident, and the clean blue Texas title is in hand.
Being the XLE trim, it comes with plenty of convenient features, including a moonroof, touchscreen navigation system, backup camera, Bluetooth, AUX and USB connectivity, keyless entry and push-button start, power-adjustable seats, cruise control, an auto-dimming rearview mirror, remote trunk release, and more.
The White exterior looks great for its age and gets hand buffed and waxed every year. The beige interior is also in very nice condition and has been well cared for.
The Toyo tires are in excellent shape with plenty of tread remaining, and they are nitrogen-filled. Even the spare tire is still brand new and has never been used.
It runs and drives great and offers plenty of room for both passengers and cargo. The rear seats fold flat to give you additional space when needed, making it practical for everyday driving, shopping, or road trips.
It comes with both original keyless fobs and all the original owner's manuals. We’re happy to let you look everything over and bring your own mechanic for an independent inspection before purchasing.
The asking price is $12,400 cash, and I’m firm on the price. Considering the mileage, condition, and one-owner history, I believe it’s a fair price for this Camry, comparable Camrys at dealerships are listed for $14,500 and up. Serious buyers are welcome to come see it and take it for a test drive. Please reach out only if you’re genuinely interested, as I won’t be able to hold the vehicle for anyone.
